Fine graphite pencil drawing with delicate light hatching, clean mid-grey contours, pale fills, pure WHITE empty ground. Match the attached house-style reference for the same neutral adult, fitted t-shirt, shorts, plain training shoes and a completely blank FACELESS head. Improve the ankle action so this cannot read as ordinary walking.
COUNTABLE FACTS: true side view facing RIGHT, upright torso, head over hips. Exactly TWO legs and TWO feet on each figure. BOTH ankles dorsiflexed, soles angled upward about 20 degrees to horizontal, with forefeet and toes HIGH and obviously OFF the ground. Heel is the LOWEST point. Show a PLAIN VISIBLE WEDGE OF WHITE AIR below the entire front two-thirds of EACH shoe. Front toe bottom at least 25 pixels ABOVE a thin horizontal floor datum in a 1536px-wide image. The sole itself is straight and diagonal, not a flat sole with an upturned decorative toe. The heel alone touches the floor. Right panel: NEXT stride with the other leg now forward, both toes still actively pulled up; use a slightly longer gap between heels than left. A natural small walking step, not standing on tiptoe, not running. Successive steps must differ visibly, with one knee slightly bent as that leg passes through, yet torso remains erect. No foot flat, no toe touching floor. Keep shoes large enough to see the lifted sole at 420px; show entire figures including both heels.
A single thin curved arrow joins the two panels. No equipment. Two arms, two hands with natural five fingers each, no extra fingers, no extra limbs.
